new_or_strengthened_atoms.claim: Perception Control has a real central enforcement primitive: unknown heads, COMPUTE_OFF heads, and heads tainted by an upstream COMPUTE_OFF or unknown dependency return status=NOT_COMPUTED and value=None before compute_fn executes. Caller-supplied dependency lists do not override the central dependency DAG.
new_or_strengthened_atoms.grid10_delta: Port the semantic invariant into WorldNeed/WorldSlice and GRID head evaluation: protected or unknown variables must remain NOT_COMPUTED through downstream transformation chains; no vector similarity, inverse decomposition, or cached projection may silently reconstruct a disabled axis.
new_or_strengthened_atoms.boundary: System-wide privacy credit is not granted until source-wide live reachability proves sensitive callers cannot bypass evaluate_head and call raw compute functions directly.

new_or_strengthened_atoms.claim: VoiceSessionCapsule refreshes live presence, visual state, cognition/arbitration, memory references, privacy policy and tool policy into RAM only and therefore is a useful noncanonical compiler/view rather than a second memory authority. Its inputs are read from multiple sources without one explicit cross-source generation/transaction identity.
new_or_strengthened_atoms.grid10_delta: Keep the capsule successor ephemeral. Add a bounded source-generation/provenance digest so a voice projection can be rejected or refreshed when decision-relevant source generations disagree, rather than treating a mixed-time snapshot as one coherent fact.

new_or_strengthened_atoms.claim: RealtimeSession constructs and refreshes the capsule, but _response_erstellen() still builds response.instructions from _instruktion(self._zustandstext) plus an optional hint. The capsule itself is not compiled into normal per-response conditioning.
new_or_strengthened_atoms.grid10_delta: Triggerword-4 should add one minimal provenance-bearing Voice/GRID context compiler with bounded token/privacy/freshness rules. Measure the intended causal edge with field-level lesion/shuffle controls instead of injecting the whole capsule blindly.

new_or_strengthened_atoms.claim: When PresenceBridge is unavailable or yields no user_present value, the donor path explicitly falls back to user_present=True even though the capsule can otherwise represent missing presence signal. This converts UNKNOWN sensor evidence into a positive presence fact for arbitration.
new_or_strengthened_atoms.grid10_delta: Unavailable presence must remain UNKNOWN/None. GRID/voice gating must choose WAIT, ASK, re-observe, or a non-presence-dependent path explicitly; missing evidence must never mint presence.

new_or_strengthened_atoms.claim: Realtime stores emitted function calls as pending and discards them when the parent response is cancelled or the user barges in before dispatch. Only completed responses dispatch those pending calls.
new_or_strengthened_atoms.grid10_delta: Generalize this into a typed candidate-effect lifecycle: CANCELLED or SUPERSEDED parent cognition invalidates undelivered EffectRequests before EffectGate. Once an external effect has been submitted, cancellation cannot be treated as non-execution; outcome may remain UNKNOWN and must be verified rather than replayed.

new_or_strengthened_atoms.claim: The normal PreToolUse path records ZUGELASSEN/ABGELEHNT/WIEDERHOLUNG/UNGEPRUEFT but emits no block decision. PostToolUse may create VERIFIED/FEHLGESCHLAGEN evidence even when no pre-row existed. Downstream semantics therefore must not infer prior admission authority from successful execution or one overloaded status field.
new_or_strengthened_atoms.grid10_delta: Maintain distinct EffectRequest, ADMISSION_DECISION, ENFORCEMENT_DECISION, EXECUTION_RECEIPT, WORLD_EFFECT_VERIFICATION and COMPLETION_EVIDENCE identities. Successful execution never retroactively creates admission authority.

effect_plane: Keep donor redaction, generation/precondition checks, outcome hashing and append-only evidence ideas, but not its nonblocking admission semantics as the final EffectGate.
Use immutable per-call invocation identity rather than one mutable session-wide active_turns.effect_id pointer.
Cancellation before dispatch is a useful donor invariant; post-submission uncertainty is a different state and remains UNKNOWN until verified.
world_substrate: Use Perception Control's NOT_COMPUTED plus dependency-taint rule as the direct control-plane donor for sparse WorldNeed/WorldSlice generation.
A disabled or unknown primitive cannot be reconstructed indirectly by decomposition, transform chains, vector nearest-neighbor retrieval or downstream heads.
Preserve typed provenance/epistemics outside vectors; similarity and model projection remain candidate structure only.
voice_plane: Keep VoiceSessionCapsule as an ephemeral compiler/view over canonical sources, never a second state store.
Add generation/provenance binding across capsule inputs before using the projection for stronger autonomous decisions.
Compile only a minimal tested slice into per-response expression conditioning.
Replace UNKNOWN->True presence fallback with explicit UNKNOWN and WAIT/ASK/re-observe semantics.

contradictions.resolution: stern.py normal PreToolUse is conclusively nonblocking bookkeeping. The separately referenced historical/external blocker and its current reachability still must be mapped before describing the whole donor effect architecture.
The degraded voice path explicitly maps absent PresenceBridge evidence to user_present=True; Triggerword-4 must remove this epistemic promotion.
Capsule refresh is real, but normal response.create instructions still omit the capsule projection; an explicit bounded context compiler is required.

Source structure still uses one session pointer. Keep this as an open concurrency defect candidate until the real scheduler is traced or an admitted parallel-call regression demonstrates interleaving; 2.0 design should not depend on that ambiguity and should bind immutable per-call identity.

next_exact_gate: Recover the actual historical/current blocking wache-koenig or successor and real hook scheduler ordering, then bind the complete request->admission->enforcement->execution->verification->completion graph to immutable per-call identity. In parallel, Triggerword-4 should port NOT_COMPUTED dependency taint into WorldSlice/GRID controls and repair UNKNOWN presence plus the missing bounded Voice/GRID per-response context compiler.
